topics.title: What Is IoT?
topics.summary: See how the internet grew from screens to everyday objects, and what turns an ordinary device into a connected smart one.

topics.title: IoT Architecture: Devices, Gateways, Cloud
topics.summary: Learn the layered reference architecture every IoT system follows, from sensor to gateway to cloud to app.

topics.title: Electronics Basics: Voltage, Current, Circuits
topics.summary: Use Ohm's law, resistors, LEDs, and a breadboard to build simple circuits without damaging parts.

topics.title: Sensors and Actuators
topics.summary: Know the common inputs like temperature, motion, and light, and outputs like motors, relays, and displays.

topics.title: Analog vs Digital Signals
topics.summary: Understand ADCs, DACs, sampling rate, and resolution, and why a sensor reading never exactly matches reality.

topics.title: Microcontrollers vs Microprocessors
topics.summary: Compare boards like Arduino and ESP32 with the Raspberry Pi on power, cost, and capability, and pick the right one.

topics.title: Arduino Fundamentals
topics.summary: Write your first sketches in the Arduino IDE to read inputs and drive outputs with digital and analog I/O.

topics.title: GPIO, I2C, SPI, and UART
topics.summary: Connect sensors and modules using pins and the serial buses chips use to talk, and debug wiring when nothing responds.

topics.title: Embedded C Basics
topics.summary: Write firmware that respects tight memory, using volatile, interrupts, bit manipulation, and no dynamic allocation.

topics.title: Soldering and Hardware Prototyping
topics.summary: Move a project from breadboard to perfboard with safe, reliable soldering and tidy wiring.

topics.title: Raspberry Pi Basics
topics.summary: Set up a Raspberry Pi running Linux and use it when a project needs more power than a microcontroller offers.

topics.title: Networking Fundamentals for IoT
topics.summary: Understand IP addresses, TCP versus UDP, DNS, and routers so you can explain how a device's data reaches the internet.

topics.title: Wi-Fi for IoT
topics.summary: Connect an ESP32 to Wi-Fi and understand when Wi-Fi is the right choice and where its power and range limits hurt.

topics.title: IoT Communication Protocols Overview
topics.summary: Get a map of HTTP, MQTT, CoAP, and AMQP and what each one is optimized for.

topics.title: HTTP for IoT
topics.summary: Send sensor readings to a web API over HTTP, and learn the bandwidth and battery cost of this simple approach.

topics.title: Your First Connected Sensor Project
topics.summary: Build an end-to-end project that reads a sensor on an ESP32, sends data to the cloud, and shows it on a simple dashboard.

topics.title: Power Considerations and Battery Life
topics.summary: Estimate battery life and extend it with sleep modes, duty cycling, and energy harvesting, the constraint that shapes every design.

topics.title: IoT vs Industrial IoT (IIoT)
topics.summary: Contrast consumer devices with factory-floor systems and their different reliability bars, protocols, and budgets.

topics.title: Privacy and Ethics in IoT
topics.summary: Consider what always-on sensors collect, who owns that data, and where meaningful consent breaks down.

topics.title: Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS)
topics.summary: Structure firmware into tasks, queues, and timers with FreeRTOS so a device can handle sensing and networking at once.

topics.title: MQTT in Depth
topics.summary: Use publish and subscribe, topics, QoS levels, retained messages, and last will, the protocol most IoT projects settle on.

topics.title: CoAP Protocol
topics.summary: Use REST-style requests over UDP with CoAP when HTTP is too heavy for a constrained device or network.

topics.title: IoT with Node-RED
topics.summary: Wire devices, MQTT topics, and APIs together visually with Node-RED flows to prototype integrations quickly.

topics.title: Bluetooth and BLE
topics.summary: Build low-energy links for wearables and beacons, and understand advertising, connections, and the GATT data model.

topics.title: Zigbee and Z-Wave
topics.summary: Compare the two classic smart-home mesh protocols, their vendor ecosystems, and how they relate to Matter.

topics.title: Mesh Networks
topics.summary: Learn how devices relay for each other in Thread, Zigbee, and BLE Mesh, and the routing and reliability tradeoffs involved.

topics.title: Smart Home Standards (Matter)
topics.summary: Understand how Matter over Thread and Wi-Fi brings cross-vendor interoperability to the smart home, and its current gaps.

topics.title: Home Assistant
topics.summary: Run the open-source smart home hub, add integrations, and write automations that tie your devices together locally.

topics.title: LoRaWAN
topics.summary: Send small packets over kilometres on very little power with LoRaWAN, and understand gateways, network servers, and duty limits.

topics.title: Cellular IoT (NB-IoT, LTE-M)
topics.summary: Use carrier networks with NB-IoT and LTE-M when devices need coverage everywhere, and plan for data costs and SIMs.

topics.title: 5G and IoT
topics.summary: See what massive machine communication, network slicing, and ultra-low latency in 5G actually enable for IoT.

topics.title: Industrial Protocols (Modbus, OPC-UA)
topics.summary: Read data from PLCs and industrial equipment over Modbus and OPC-UA, and bridge it into IT systems.

topics.title: IoT Gateways
topics.summary: Build a gateway that translates device protocols to cloud protocols, processes data locally, and buffers through outages.

topics.title: Edge Computing for IoT
topics.summary: Decide what to process on the device or gateway versus the cloud to win on latency, bandwidth, privacy, and resilience.

topics.title: AWS IoT Core
topics.summary: Connect devices to AWS with certificates, device shadows, the rules engine, and fleet provisioning.

topics.title: Azure IoT Hub
topics.summary: Manage devices on Azure with device twins, direct methods, and jobs through Microsoft's managed IoT broker.

topics.title: Google Cloud IoT
topics.summary: Learn the Pub/Sub-based design of Google Cloud IoT Core, its 2023 retirement, and the migration paths teams took.

topics.title: IoT Device Provisioning
topics.summary: Onboard devices at scale with zero-touch provisioning and X.509 certificates so each one gets a unique identity.

topics.title: Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates
topics.summary: Ship firmware updates remotely with signed images, A/B partitions, atomic installs, and automatic rollback.

topics.title: IoT Device Lifecycle Management
topics.summary: Manage fleets through provisioning, monitoring, updating, and secure decommissioning across thousands of devices.

topics.title: Time-Series Data and IoT
topics.summary: Understand why sensor data is time-series and the storage, retention, and query patterns it demands.

topics.title: InfluxDB for Sensor Data
topics.summary: Store and query telemetry in InfluxDB using buckets, retention policies, and downsampling.

topics.title: Stream Processing for IoT
topics.summary: Process events as they arrive with Kafka, Flink, or Kinesis to detect anomalies and trigger actions in real time.

topics.title: Real-Time Dashboards
topics.summary: Turn live telemetry into dashboards and alerts with Grafana or a custom web app that people can act on.

topics.title: IoT Cost Optimization
topics.summary: Cut per-device cloud and connectivity costs with message batching, edge filtering, and the right data plans.

topics.title: IoT Security Threats
topics.summary: Survey the IoT attack surface, from default passwords to unpatched firmware and insecure APIs, using the OWASP IoT Top 10.

topics.title: IoT Botnets: The Mirai Case Study
topics.summary: Trace how Mirai hijacked weak devices to launch record DDoS attacks, and what laws and vendors changed afterwards.

topics.title: Securing MQTT
topics.summary: Lock down brokers with TLS, client certificates, and topic ACLs, and avoid the many brokers exposed online without auth.

topics.title: Device Identity and PKI
topics.summary: Give every device a strong identity with X.509 certificates, hardware-backed keys, and remote attestation.

topics.title: Secure Boot and Trusted Execution
topics.summary: Build a chain of trust from boot ROM to application with secure boot, TPMs, secure elements, and TrustZone.

topics.title: Penetration Testing IoT Devices
topics.summary: Attack your own devices through UART and JTAG ports, firmware extraction, radio sniffing, and fuzzing.

topics.title: Privacy by Design in IoT
topics.summary: Engineer privacy in with data minimization, on-device processing, and retention limits rather than bolting it on.

topics.title: TinyML and Edge AI
topics.summary: Run machine learning inference on microcontrollers with quantized models under a megabyte, and know the use cases that fit.

topics.title: TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers
topics.summary: Train, convert, and deploy a neural network that fits in 256 KB of RAM, with the optimization tricks that make it run.

topics.title: Embedded Vision
topics.summary: Process images on cheap devices like OpenMV and ESP32-CAM for detection and counting tasks at the edge.

topics.title: Voice Interfaces
topics.summary: Understand on-device wake-word detection and cloud speech recognition, the split architecture behind smart speakers.

topics.title: Federated Learning on Edge
topics.summary: Train models across many devices without centralizing raw data, and handle the privacy and bandwidth tradeoffs.

topics.title: Wearable Computing
topics.summary: Design wrist-worn and body sensors tethered over BLE, and survey watchOS, Wear OS, and RTOS-based platforms.

topics.title: Healthcare IoT (Medical Devices)
topics.summary: Understand FDA clearance, HIPAA, and safety standards, the regulatory bar that consumer IoT never has to clear.

topics.title: Smart City Architectures
topics.summary: Design citywide sensor networks for traffic, parking, and air quality, along with the data-governance models they need.

topics.title: Connected Vehicles
topics.summary: Explore OBD-II, CAN bus, V2X, and vehicle OTA updates, the IoT domain with the highest safety stakes.

topics.title: Agriculture IoT
topics.summary: Apply soil sensors, LoRaWAN links, drones, and automated irrigation to precision farming in remote areas.

topics.title: Industry 4.0 and Smart Manufacturing
topics.summary: Use IIoT for predictive maintenance, digital twins, and OEE tracking on the factory floor.

topics.title: Building an IoT Product End-to-End
topics.summary: Take a product from idea through hardware design, firmware, cloud, app, certification, and manufacturing.

topics.title: Career Paths in IoT and Embedded
topics.summary: Map firmware, hardware, cloud, security, and product roles in IoT and the skill mix each one requires.
topics.from: Career Paths in IoT and Embedded
